Read SAAM Airport SID Points File

Source: R/read_sid.R
read_sid.Rd

Reads and parses a .sid file containing a list of airport Standard Instrument Departure (SID) points. The file format is expected to be whitespace-separated, where the first column is the 4-character ICAO airport code and subsequent columns are navigation point names.

Usage

read_sid(sid_file_name)

Arguments

sid_file_name

A single character string specifying the path to the .sid file.

Value

A data.table with two columns:

icao_apt

Character. The ICAO airport code (e.g., "SAAM").

sid

Character. The SID navigation point name.

If the file is empty or contains no valid data, an empty data.table is returned.

Details

The function relies on data.table::fread for high-performance reading and stringi for efficient text processing. It handles:

  • Blank lines and whitespace trimming automatically.

  • Files with no SIDs (returns empty table).

  • Lines containing only an ICAO code (ignored, as there are no SIDs to list).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Assuming 'airports.sid' exists in your working directory
dt <- read_sid("airports.sid")
print(dt)
} # }
